title: AKS · Cluster overview
description: Stato complessivo del cluster AKS: nodi, capacità, workload, namespace, autoscaling, storage e rete. Azure Managed Prometheus. Le sezioni Workload/Namespace/HPA/PVC seguono il filtro Namespace; overview e nodi sono sempre a livello cluster.

panels.title: Nodi
panels.description: Nodi registrati nel cluster.

targets.expr: count(kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Nodi non Ready
panels.description: Nodi con condizione Ready diversa da true.

targets.expr: count(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster", condition="Ready", status!="true"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodi sotto pressione
panels.description: Nodi con MemoryPressure, DiskPressure o PIDPressure attiva.

targets.expr: count(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure", status="true"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pod Running
panels.description: Pod in fase Running.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase="Running"})

panels.title: Pod Pending
panels.description: Pod in Pending: spesso mancano risorse sui nodi o PVC non bound.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase="Pending"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container in errore
panels.description: Container in waiting per CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError, ecc.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", reason!~"ContainerCreating|PodInitializing"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Workload degradati
panels.description: Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet con meno repliche disponibili di quelle desiderate.

targets.expr: (count((max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster"})) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count((max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$cluster"})) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count((max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster"})) > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Restart ultima ora
panels.description: Restart dei container nell'ultima ora.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU in uso
panels.description: CPU usata dai nodi / CPU totale dei nodi (node-exporter).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m]))) / sum(count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode="idle"})) * 100

panels.title: CPU richiesta
panels.description: Somma delle CPU request dei pod attivi / CPU allocatable dei nodi. Vicino al 100% i nuovi pod restano Pending.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"}) * 100

panels.title: CPU limit (overcommit)
panels.description: Somma dei CPU limit / allocatable. Oltre 100% il cluster è in overcommit.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"}) * 100

panels.title: Memoria in uso
panels.description: Memoria usata dai nodi (MemTotal - MemAvailable) / MemTotal.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) / sum(sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * 100

panels.title: Memoria richiesta
panels.description: Somma delle memory request dei pod attivi / memoria allocatable.

targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"}) * 100

panels.title: Pod / capacità
panels.description: Pod attivi / numero massimo di pod schedulabili (max-pods dei nodi).

targets.expr: count((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="pods"}) * 100

panels.title: CPU cluster
panels.description: Uso reale contro request, limit e capacità allocatable (core).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))

sum (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))
sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Memoria cluster
panels.description: Uso reale contro request, limit e capacità allocatable.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))

sum (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))
sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Stato nodi
panels.description: Uso reale (node-exporter) e risorse richieste dai pod per ogni nodo.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster", condition="Ready", status="true"}), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m])) / count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode="idle"}) * 100, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*"), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"}) * 100, "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(label_replace((sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) / sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 100, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*"), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory"}) * 100, "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(count by (node) (max by (node, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster", node!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")
label_replace(sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="pods"}), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

label_replace(label_replace(max by (instance) (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext4|xfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext4|xfs"}) * 100, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*"), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")
label_replace(count by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure", status="true"} == 1), "nodepool", "$1", "node", "aks-([^-]+)-.*")

panels.title: CPU per nodo
panels.description: Percentuale di CPU usata per nodo.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])) / count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", mode="idle"}) * 100, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")

panels.title: Memoria per nodo
panels.description: Percentuale di memoria usata per nodo.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) - sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) / sum by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 100, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")

panels.title: Workload degradati
panels.description: Workload con repliche disponibili inferiori alle desiderate. Vuota = tutto ok.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace((max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) - max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})) > 0, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace((max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) - max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})) > 0, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace((max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) - max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})) > 0, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "")) or max by (namespace, workload, kind) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}), "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

panels.title: Container in errore
panels.description: Container bloccati in waiting (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ...).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", reason!~"ContainerCreating|PodInitializing"}) > 0

panels.title: Pod Pending
panels.description: Pod in attesa di essere schedulati o avviati.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Pending"}) == 1

panels.title: Top 10 restart (24h)
panels.description: Pod con più restart nelle ultime 24 ore.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h])) >= 1)

panels.title: OOMKilled (24h)
panels.description: Container terminati per OOM che hanno riavviato nelle ultime 24 ore: memory limit troppo basso.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", reason="OOMKilled"}) and on (namespace, pod, container) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h])) >= 1)

panels.title: Risorse per namespace
panels.description: Uso reale contro request. Uso/request basso = namespace sovradimensionato (vedi la dashboard Rightsizing).

targets.expr: count by (namespace) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Running"}) == 1)
sum by (namespace) (node_namespace_pod_container:container_cpu_usage_seconds_total:sum_irate{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})

sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))
sum by (namespace) (node_namespace_pod_container:container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})

sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1))
round(sum by (namespace) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[24h])))

panels.title: CPU per namespace (top 10)
panels.description: Core usati per namespace (recording rule sum_irate).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace) (node_namespace_pod_container:container_cpu_usage_seconds_total:sum_irate{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}))

panels.title: Memoria per namespace (top 10)
panels.description: Working set per namespace.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace) (node_namespace_pod_container:container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}))

panels.title: HPA
panels.description: Autoscaler: al 100% del massimo l'HPA non può più scalare.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_min_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, horizontalpodautoscaler) (kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_desired_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Volumi persistenti (PVC)
panels.description: Spazio usato per PVC montata (kubelet volume stats). Oltre 85% rischio disco pieno.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Traffico per nodo (rx su, tx giù)
panels.description: Byte/s ricevuti e trasmessi dalle interfacce fisiche dei nodi.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"lo|veth.*|azv.*|cali.*|cilium.*|lxc.*|docker.*|cni.*|flannel.*|vxlan.*|tunl.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")

label_replace(sum by (instance) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"lo|veth.*|azv.*|cali.*|cilium.*|lxc.*|docker.*|cni.*|flannel.*|vxlan.*|tunl.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+).*")

panels.title: Traffico ricevuto per namespace (top 10)
panels.description: Byte/s ricevuti dai pod, aggregati per namespace (cAdvisor).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))
